region: India office calendar — Hindu, Muslim, Christian, Sikh, Jain, Jewish, Buddhist. Ramadan uses India moon-sighting; Hindu/Jain tithis use New Delhi panchang.
note: mode=fast means caution observers not to eat. festive means greet and eat. fast-and-festive does both. Dates can shift by a day by city and tradition.

dates.label: Krishna Janmashtami
dates.greeting: Happy Janmashtami. If you are fasting till midnight, Dew will not shove lunch at you.

dates.label: Dahi Handi / Nandotsav
dates.greeting: Happy Dahi Handi. Eat, share, Dew is on festival duty.

dates.label: Aja Ekadashi
dates.greeting: Aja Ekadashi. If you observe, skip grains. Everyone else, the canteen is still real.

dates.greeting: Micchami Dukkadam. Forgive and be forgiven. If you are fasting today, Dew will not push food.

dates.label: Rama Ekadashi
dates.greeting: Rama Ekadashi. If you observe, skip grains. Dew still believes in water.

dates.label: Dhanteras

dates.label: Choti Diwali / Naraka Chaturdashi
dates.greeting: Shubh Choti Diwali. South India, this may be your main night. Eat, light up, Dew is glowing.

dates.label: Diwali / Bandi Chhor Divas / Mahavir Nirvana
dates.greeting: Shubh Deepavali. Bandi Chhor Divas. Mahavir Nirvana. Lights, langar, sweets. Dew is on festival duty — eat.

dates.label: Govardhan Puja / Annakut
dates.greeting: Shubh Govardhan / Annakut. A mountain of food is the point. Dew will not stop you.

dates.label: Bhai Dooj
dates.greeting: Happy Bhai Dooj. Tilak, sweets, siblings. Dew is sentimental and hydrated.

dates.label: Devutthana Ekadashi / Prabodhini
dates.greeting: Prabodhini Ekadashi. Vishnu wakes, Chaturmas ends. Observe the vrat if that is you; Dew still says the greeting.

dates.label: Guru Nanak Jayanti / Kartik Purnima
dates.greeting: Guru Nanak Jayanti. Satnam. Langar is the theology of lunch. Eat, Dew is in line.

dates.label: First Sunday of Advent
dates.greeting: Blessed Advent. A quiet wait. Dew will still nag water, softer today.
